title: Design System: NOL Studio

body.purpose: Compact readable Arial copy; folder-name inputs and selection counts use Arial at 20px. Enabled draft instructions, caption metadata, generic-field placeholders, folder counts, Ungroup files and Clear all use warm gray at 80% opacity. Add instructions is 12px; Ungroup files is 13px. Armed Clear all uses action red with dark text and keeps two-tap confirmation.

components.css: .ds-account{position:relative;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#dedede}.ds-account>summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#dedede;font-size:13px;min-height:36px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px}.ds-account>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-account>summary:hover,.ds-account[open]>summary{background:#171717;border-color:#303030}.ds-account-panel{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);right:0;width:min(260px,calc(100vw - 40px));padding:16px;border:1px solid #353535;border-radius:5px;background:#151515;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #0008}.ds-account-panel p{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 14px}.ds-account-panel dl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;font-size:12px;margin:0 0 14px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #333}.ds-account-panel dt{color:#aaa}.ds-account-panel dd{text-align:right;margin:0}.ds-account-panel button{display:block;width:100%;min-height:40px;padding:8px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:none;color:inherit;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px}.ds-account-panel button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#242424}.ds-account summary:focus-visible,.ds-account button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ef6058;outline-offset:5px}.ds-account button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-account>summary{font-size:12px;padding-right:0}}

narrative.overview: This is the implemented **authenticated Studio workspace**, not the public portfolio, sign-in or onboarding identity. The small NOL wordmark retains Archivo Black. Normal-case Arial headings and drop names keep the working surface quiet and compact. There is no animated Backdrop in the authenticated workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed desktop side navigation and fixed mobile bottom navigation.
One upload canvas; Help owns the tutorial.
Unboxed status text, divided drop rows and understated inline replies.
Red actions, visible upload choices and explicit publication approval.
dos: **Do** keep the NOL wordmark small and workspace headings in normal-case Arial.
**Do** preserve visible file/folder actions and the separate New drop, Your drops and Help destinations.
**Do** preserve truthful worker/drop status, revision, retry and explicit publish confirmation.
**Do** describe drafts as device- and origin-local, with storage-failure feedback.
**Do** keep the mobile draft dock above bottom navigation.
donts: **Don't** restore the large editorial headings, top tab bar or upload tutorial sidebar.
**Don't** turn statuses and replies into prominent filled cards.
**Don't** add the animated Backdrop to the authenticated workspace.
**Don't** imply sending, retrying or requesting changes publishes work.
**Don't** claim cross-device draft synchronization or full visual approval from incomplete captures.

notes: Color ramps are synthesized preview extensions, not implemented CSS scales.
No new creative north star was invented; the incumbent NOL identity remains authoritative.
Component snippets resolve scoped workspace tokens to literals so shadow-DOM previews render independently.
